description: Query the terminal/pending status of a pending ICA request from the PE primary (GET /puppet-ca/v1/intermediate-ca/requests/:id). Runs on the primary. Authenticates with mTLS only -- per SPEC.md sec 3.2 this endpoint needs no RBAC token, the request UUID is the authorization. Used by peadm::poll_ica_approval (ticket 7.6).

request_id.description: The pending ICA request id to look up.
